title: Ambiguous multi-item visual request
tests: Whether the agent settles an ambiguous visual request before building (the harness spec-table and assumptions gate) instead of guessing. The scripted user holds one intended reading and reveals it only when asked. Measures asking before building, wrong-build events and whether the final result matches the intended reading.
hiddenReading: Only the cards under Today's specials change; the Regulars cards stay as they are.
Photos about twice as tall as now (about 240px).
The price becomes a small tag over the photo, in its top-right corner.
Only the Vegan badge turns green, wherever it appears; the New badge stays yellow.
